text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
—The next idea is:
'Boil boba in Nambu ironware and hand it out'!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Uhh... sounds fun, but
will that really promote Morioka...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Promoting Morioka... She must mean the
'Travelling Morioka Festival' from the other day.
Yukino Bijin did say she was going to advertise it...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer-san! Perfect timing.
Right now, I'm brainstormin' ways to promote that event,
and I'd love to hear your thoughts~!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
How about a "flash mob"?
It's modern and flashy, so wouldn't everyone be talkin' about it~?!
choice_data_list: Hmm... That might not feel very 'Morioka', though.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Uuu... I guess not...
Are there any other stylish ideas...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Look, you don't have to force yourself
to come up with some trendy, stylish pitch, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Instead of trying so hard to stand out,
wouldn't it be better to just straightforwardly share
the good things you know about Morioka?
choice_data_list: You told me about that at the fair too, remember?
You told me about that at the fair too, remember?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Does that mean... perhaps,
what I told ya about the 'Sansa Odori'?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Huh... So you have fond memories of it?
Couldn't something like that give you a hint?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Well now... If we're talkin' fond memories...
...Ah—!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Back in elementary school, I played the Sansa drum
at a local festival! You strap a drum to your belly
and beat it while you march along, but—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
—it was downright tough, let me tell ya!
If your drum rhythm slips, the whole dance gets thrown off!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Ah~, I kinda get that. Whenever what you do affects everyone around you, it gets pretty nerve-wracking, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
That's so true~! An' then, while I was all down in the dumps, my taiko teacher came over and...
Hehehe, what'd ya think he said?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ...Well, ya see! He said, "It ain't no big deal even if you mess up!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: "Sansa is somethin' where ya walk a long way while repeatin' the same phrase over an' over, after all."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: "No matter how many times ya stumble, ya can start over as many times as ya like. As long as ya have fun and finish with a smile, that's all that matters—"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: —"Dondo bare," meanin' 'and they lived happily ever after,' he told me!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Hmm, that's pretty nice, honestly. Like, staying natural without trying too hard to look cool?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ...Ah—! That's it... bein' able to stay natural.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: That's definitely it, isn't it...! What I love about Morioka is this very thing... how everyone can smile without puttin' on airs!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Heh, now that's a good look on you. Just convey that straight from the heart.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I-I see...! But, how should I go about sharin' that with folks...?
choice_data_list: Let's have them experience it firsthand!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Experience... Ah, if that's the case—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, while passing by the dance studio, I saw Yukino Bijin practicing the taiko drum.
Gold City was dancing along to the beat as well.

text_block_list.name: Karen Chan
text_block_list.text:
Wah! I wondered where that drum beat was coming from♪
Hey, hey, what kind of dance is that? I totally wanna try it~!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Hawa! If it isn't Karen-san!
Please, by all means, let me teach ya how to dance it~!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
—One, two, one, two!
Yes, yes, just like that~~~!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: A-Alright, on the day of the event, if I beat the drum like this, maybe lots of folks will gather around too...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: A video...! I see, that way we can spread the word to the whole wide world!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Sounds good. Leave the filming to me!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
W-Welcome, one and all! It's the "Morioka Roadshow Festival"~!
Here comes the Sansa Odori~ ready, go~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, they captured a video of Yukino Bijin dancing and chatting in her true, natural element.
Then, a few days later—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Yaaay! Sansaaa~~!!
Sakkora choiwaa~?

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Yasseeeeee☆
Yaaaay~~!!

text_block_list.name: Karen Chan
text_block_list.text: Sansa is so super cute~! Karen's gonna post a "Dance Cover" video too♪

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
"Yukino-chan, I saw your Umatok video~! What an amazin' response.
There's no doubt the event's gonna be a smash hit!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
T-Thank goodness~! But if I could be of help, I'm truly delighted!
Please give it your all at the festival!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Again...?
